title: Frozen typed longwave owner/ABI contract for the primary reducer
purpose: Executable exactness gates for later variants (N8-12 Numba B, N8-13 native C): any new consumer must reproduce the typed graph below bitwise (uint32 view of all seven output columns) on the admitted domain before it may replace the baseline.

baseline_lineage.change_between_b7_and_head: only the _lw_kernel env dispatcher and one driver line were added; _longwave_primary and _longwave_primary_serial bodies are byte-identical
baseline_lineage.compilation: numba njit(cache=True, fastmath=False); parallel=True (prange over pixels) for _longwave_primary, serial range loop for _longwave_primary_serial
baseline_lineage.out_of_scope_family: _longwave_fused_primary* (env SOLWEIG_LIGHT_FUSED_RAD, default OFF in all captures) is a separate typed family and is NOT frozen by this record

environment.test_threads: pinned via numba.set_num_threads(min(4, NUMBA_NUM_THREADS)) in tests/optimization_v8/reference/conftest.py; kernel is thread-count-invariant by construction (per-pixel accumulators, no cross-pixel reduction); parallel==serial asserted bitwise

signature.returns: float32 [B,7], owned by the kernel (freshly allocated)

input_types.sh_vs_vb: float32 [B,P]; real path C-contiguous writeable; raw values need not be 0/1 (they feed exact predicates)
input_types.directions: float32 [P,4] C-contiguous readonly; NEVER READ by the reducer body (shape/dtype checked only)
input_types.gate: bool [P,4] C-contiguous readonly; NEVER READ by the reducer body
input_types.sky_down_sky_side: float32 [P], ANY element stride (real path: stride-12 column-2 views of [P,3] tables); negative strides admitted by the numba kernels
input_types.surface_sun_surface_sh: TWO admitted provenances: float64 (numpy float64 scalar or Python float -- the real accepted pipeline) and float32 (numpy float32 scalar -- synthetic). These are DIFFERENT typed graphs; both sun and shade scalars must come from the same provenance
input_types.reflection_factor: np.float32 scalar or 0-d float32 ndarray (stays float32; a Python float would promote the reflection chain to float64 and is NOT admitted)

state.accumulators: ten float32 a0..a9 per pixel, initialized to the reference zero +0.0 (bits 0x00000000) at the start of each pixel

roles.a0: sky down (sweep 1); also the sole reflection input together with lup

state.output_mapping: col0 = left-fold(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4); col1 = left-fold(a5,a6,a7,a8,a9); cols 2..6 = a5,a6,a7,a8,a9 verbatim

sweep_1_per_patch_p_in_0_to_P_minus_1: sky  = (shv == 1) and (vsv == 1)            [literal promotes to float64 compare; truth-identical to float32 compare]
veg  = (vsv == 0) or (vbv == 0)             [short-circuit or; value semantics identical to bitwise or]
building = ( RN32(1.0f - shv) * vbv ) == 1  [float32 subtract, float32 multiply, EXACT comparison; raw non-0/1 values are meaningful, e.g. sh=1-2^-23 with vb=2^23 is building=true]
a0 = RN32(a0 + RN32(sky * sky_down[p]))     [pure float32 chain: bool -> 0.0f/1.0f multiply]
ST chain (profile-dependent, see profiles): c_side  = (((surface_sh ST-op solid[p]) ST-op cosine[p]) ST-op veg)
a6 = RN32( f64(a6) + c_side )  -- the ONLY rounding is the final store; NEVER a6 = RN32(a6 + RN32(c_side))
a1 = RN32( f64(a1) + c_down )  with c_down = (((surface_sh ST solid[p]) ST sine[p]) ST veg)
if solar_gate[p] (REAL branch; the inactive arm is NOT evaluated -- no vector select convenience):
a8 = RN32(f64(a8) + ((((surface_sun ST sun_bp) ST solid[p]) ST cosine[p]) ST building))
a7 = RN32(f64(a7) + ((((surface_sh  ST shade_bp) ST solid[p]) ST cosine[p]) ST building))
a3 = RN32(f64(a3) + ((((surface_sun ST sun_bp) ST solid[p]) ST sine[p])  ST building))
a2 = RN32(f64(a2) + ((((surface_sh  ST shade_bp) ST solid[p]) ST sine[p])  ST building))
a7 = RN32(f64(a7) + (((surface_sh ST solid[p]) ST cosine[p]) ST building))
a2 = RN32(f64(a2) + (((surface_sh ST solid[p]) ST sine[p])  ST building))
reflection_after_sweep_1: reads the COMPLETED first-sweep a0 and lup[pixel] (a barrier between the sweeps: reflection must not be interleaved into sweep 1)
r1 = RN32(r0 * reflection_factor)             [float32 multiply; factor is float32]
reflected = RN32(r2 / RN32(pi))               [IEEE DIVISION by the exact stored float32 pi bits 0x40490FDB; reciprocal rewrite is FORBIDDEN and bit-different]
sweep_2_per_patch_p_in_0_to_P_minus_1: side = RN32(RN32(RN32(reflected * solid[p]) * cosine[p]) * maskf)   [ALL float32]
maskf is the 0.0f/1.0f NUMBER multiply -- NOT a branch: 0*Inf = NaN and signed-zero propagation are preserved observables
a9 = RN32(a9 + side); a4 = RN32(a4 + down)
output_fold: out0 = RN32(RN32(RN32(RN32(a0 + a1) + a2) + a3) + a4)   [strict left fold]
out1 = RN32(RN32(RN32(RN32(a5 + a6) + a7) + a8) + a9)   [strict left fold]
forbidden: no warp/lane tree sum, dot product, reassociation, sorted-order accumulation or tensor-core approximation anywhere in the graph
no FMA contraction in any mixed mul+add node (fastmath=False; separate IR operations in the baseline; the native build audits assembly for fused mnemonics)
no turning mask=false into a +0 skip without the signed-zero/nonfinite proof (it is a multiply and must stay one)
no evaluation of the inactive solar_gate arm via select

f64.provenance: numpy float64 scalar or Python float (numba types Python float as float64)
f64.chain_arithmetic: surface(float64) * bool->float64 * solid(float32->float64 exact) * cosine/sine(float32->float64 exact) * predicate->float64, all in float64
f64.accumulator_rule: a = RN32( f64(a_prev) + c64 ) -- single rounding at the store
f64.real_pipeline: CONFIRMED the accepted real-path specialization (B7-02 capture of the 35x32 reference scene)

f32.chain_arithmetic: identical expression tree, every node float32
f32.accumulator_rule: a = RN32( a_prev + c32 ) -- float32 add
f32.note: synthetic specialization, also frozen with bitwise fixtures in B7-02

surface_scalar_profiles.both_required: a candidate must implement BOTH profiles or restrict its admission domain to the ones it implements bit-exactly

observables_pinned_by_tests: patch order: [2^24,1,1] vs [1,1,2^24] sky values give a0 = 2^24 (0x4B800000) vs 2^24+2 (0x4B800001); the same multiset lands differently in sweep 2 (a9) via solid
RN32 accumulation rule: surface=1+2^-25 f64, solid=[2^24,1]: a6 = 0x4B800001 (f64-then-round) while the forbidden RN32(a+RN32(c)) spelling gives 0x4B800000
pi: reflected for x=11.000000953674316 is 0x40601716 (division) not 0x40601715 (reciprocal)
0*Inf: sky=false with sky_down=+Inf gives a0 = NaN (0x7FC00000); reflected=+Inf gives a9 = NaN on visible patches (Inf*0.0f) and +Inf on occluded patches
signed zeros: (+0) + (-0) = +0 in a0/lup and in the ST-chain store; -0.0 surface scalars accumulate onto +0 as +0
building predicate raw values: sh=1-2^-23 with vb=2^23 => building true (out0 = 2.0 on the pin input); vb=1 => false (out0 = 0.0)
profile separation: surface=1+2^-25, solid=[1,2^-24], cosine=1, veg on: a6 = 0x3F800001 (f64 profile) vs 0x3F800000 (f32 profile)
parallel label == serial label bitwise (scheduling is not observable); B=0 returns the (0,7) float32 zero frame without reading patch data

solar_gate branch non-evaluation has NO value-observable in the admitted domain (sun/shade are bool, surface scalars finite or uniformly applied) -- it remains an IR-level obligation from the contract text

dispatch.env: SOLWEIG_LIGHT_LW_BACKEND; unset/other => unchanged Numba kernels; 'native' or 'ispc' (case-insensitive, stripped) => optional native backend
dispatch.fallback_rule: UnsupportedInput raised BEFORE any native work => caller keeps the unchanged Numba reference fallback; any OTHER error (build failure, missing dylib) is a loud RuntimeError -- never a silent fallback
dispatch.kernel_selection: native runs the same kernel for serial and parallel labels (identical schedule: pixels across ISPC lanes, ordered patch sweeps per lane, one thread effective)

pre_launch_declines: sh/vs/vb not float32 2-d same-shape, or not C-contiguous
sky_down/sky_side not float32 [P] (any element stride IS admitted; the stride is passed natively)
directions not float32 [P,4] or gate not bool [P,4] (layout unrestricted: never read)
surface scalar provenance not in {np.float32, np.float64, Python float}, or sun/shade provenances mismatched
reflection_factor not np.float32 scalar or 0-d float32 ndarray (a Python float is REJECTED: it would promote the reflection chain)
caller-supplied out overlapping ANY input byte extent (alias rejection)
alias_and_writability: inputs are NEVER written; bool arrays cross into the ABI as zero-copy uint8 views, never recast copies
optional caller-owned out: float32 [B,7] C-contiguous; byte-extent overlap with any input is rejected pre-launch
B == 0: return the (0,7) float32 zero frame WITHOUT launching native code
the kernel is synchronous: no input can be unmapped or mutated while in flight
handle_lease_generation: library resolution must be digest-gated: lw_primary.ispc sha256 52652a598cd85ead04747a83a52b1184035c880aa0b32cf518efef06b961663c; a build_stamp.json kernel_sha256 mismatch forces a rebuild (the generation key)

dylibs live in a per-user cache (SOLWEIG_LIGHT_NATIVE_CACHE or ~/.cache/solweig-light/native), are loaded once per process and pinned (_LIBS keyed by gang); the handle is a process-lifetime lease -- close/unload during in-flight work is impossible because calls are synchronous

N8-10's workflow-owned handle must keep: PID scoping of the cache, generation = kernel digest (+ toolchain), pre-launch validation BEFORE any native allocation, and no per-block source hash/JSON/build IO inside timed regions
effective execution is single-thread (native gang=8 on arm64 neon-i32x8); thread policy changes must re-run the exactness gates
error_propagation: UnsupportedInput (pre-launch decline) -> caller falls back to the Numba kernel in the original guard order
RuntimeError from the build (ispc missing, build rc!=0, dylib missing after reported success) -> propagates loudly
post-launch failures are real backend failures and propagate; there is no partial publication (synchronous kernel, caller-owned or kernel-owned out written in full)

build_contract.audit: the build refuses to emit a library whose assembly contains any fused multiply-add mnemonic (build-time invariant, evidence ships with the build)
build_contract.entries: lw_primary_f32 (surface scalars pinned float) and lw_primary_f64 (surface scalars double); both exported from liblw_native_g4/g8.dylib

admitted_input_domain.kernel_level: B >= 0 (B=0 early-returns); P = 1..609; dtypes/strides per signature above; NaN/Inf/subnormal/signed-zero payloads anywhere in the float32 inputs flow through as values
admitted_input_domain.wrapper_level: Lcyl_v2022a_primary guards, in order: non-ndarray solar_altitude -> original reference; any of Ta/Tgwall/ewall/solar_altitude/solar_azimuth non-0-d -> reference; unsupported profile arrays -> reference; P outside 0 < P <= 609 -> reference; scalar solar_altitude in the original path raises TypeError (original failure preserved)
admitted_input_domain.production_target: P = 153 patches, block_pixels = 128 (rows*cols blocked 8x128+1x96 in the captured 35x32 scene)

transcendentals: NONE inside this reducer (no acos/classifier/SLEEF call in the primary kernels -- SLEEF obligations attach to the sky-patch/classification layers OUTSIDE this island; a native port of this island needs no math library beyond IEEE mul/add/div/compare)
